description: This line plot illustrates the mean interclass similarity across various relation categories for different experimental configurations. The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” spans from 0 to 60, representing discrete relation categories, with tick labels appearing at regular intervals of approximately 10 units. The y-axis, labeled “Mean Interclass Similarity,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.5, using a linear scale. The plot contains six distinct lines: a solid blue line with circular markers for “w/o DPO obo”; an orange line with triangle markers for “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”; a solid green line with circular markers for “DPO”; a dashed blue line with circular markers for “Average of w/o DPO obo”; a dotted orange line with triangle markers for “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”; and a dashed green line with circular markers for “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”. The solid blue line (“w/o DPO obo”) starts at approximately 0.22 and peaks sharply at 0.49 near x=1, then declines to near 0.0 by x=60. The orange line (“w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”) begins at 0.158 and exhibits high volatility, with peaks exceeding 0.4 and a trough at approximately 0.0. The green line (“DPO”) starts near 0.2, dips below 0.1, and ends near 0.086. The dashed blue line (“Average of w/o DPO obo”) remains nearly constant at approximately 0.107. The dotted orange line (“Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”) remains nearly constant at approximately 0.107. The dashed green line (“Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint”) starts near 0.086 and fluctuates slightly around that value.
